First, note: US/Eastern is UTC-5 (standard time, no DST in 1767).  
Asia/Riyadh is UTC+3.  

Source time: 18:00 (Riyadh, UTC+3) → UTC = 18:00 − 3 = 15:00 UTC.  
Target (US/Eastern, UTC-5): 15:00 UTC − 5 = 10:00 same day.  

Date: December 16, 1767 (no day change because 15:00 − 5 = 10:00).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 10:00
